title: Exact-open comparison respects restriction along one inclusion
statement: Assume the derived module categories of all schemes exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S, K∈D(O_X), and W≤U be opens of X. Use the fixed exact open adjunctions and exact nested restriction maps [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Define E(f,W,K):Rf*RjW*rW(K)≅R(jW≫f)*LjW(K) by applying Rf*RjW* to the component of leftAdjointUniq from the exact open adjunction to relativeMVAdj jW, followed by relativeMVImageComp jW f [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Then Rf*(the exact U-to-W restriction)≫E(f,W,K).hom equals E(f,U,K).hom≫relativeMVRestriction(X.homOfLE i,U.ι,W.ι,Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i,f,K). The construction also carries Rf* of the exact unit to relativeMVUnit.

proof.text: Construct E using leftAdjointUniq and relativeMVImageComp. The unit identity of leftAdjointUniq, mapped by Rf*, proves the unit formula.

For arbitrary adjunctions and a comparison L_U⋙H≅L_W, naturality and the U triangle identity show that the restricted-counit transpose composed with the U unit equals the W unit. Apply this to exact restriction and pinned pullback. Adjoint uniqueness preserves the units. Open derived direct image is fully faithful: the underived open adjunction preserves K-injectives and its counit is invertible, so fully faithful right derivation gives the assertion. Thus restriction to U of its unit is invertible by the triangle identity. Factor restriction to W through U using exact nested restriction composition; this also sends the U unit to an isomorphism. The W Hom equivalence and cancellation of this mapped unit make precomposition by the U unit injective for maps into RjW objects. Cancel it to identify the two restriction maps. Map by Rf*, insert the two relativeMVImageComp factors and cancel the U comparison with its inverse. All these calculations are proved as private helpers in the module.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08BV and 08HZ; T4: proved unit cancellation via fully faithful derived open direct image; no pinned composition coherence required

theorem relativeMVExactOpenIso_restriction {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {W U : X.Opens} (i : W ≤ U) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map
        (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X (homOfLE i)
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X U) (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X W) K) ≫
      (relativeMVExactOpenIso f W K).hom =
    (relativeMVExactOpenIso f U K).hom ≫
      relativeMVRestriction (X.homOfLE i) U.ι W.ι (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i) f K
